corpus_name: OpenStax Introduction to Python Programming - chapters 1-3
page_unit: 1-based physical PDF page number (printed page number = physical page - 10)
page_counting_rule: Content pages = every physical page inside the page ranges of chapters 1-3 (physical 17-94). Front matter (1-16: cover, title, copyright, contents, preface), chapters 4-15, answer key (371-394) and index (395-397) are not part of the corpus. A page in range is dropped and logged in results/ingest_errors.jsonl when its normalized text (after removing the running header/footer) has fewer than 300 characters (e.g. physical page 46, footer only). Chapter opener pages (17, 47, 77) are kept: besides the chapter outline they contain the chapter introduction text. Final list of counted pages and per-page character counts: data/page_index.json (generated by `python -m src.run ingest`).

filter_field.name: chapter
filter_field.type: integer stored in JSONB (compared as text)
filter_field.source_of_value: Chapter page ranges from the PDF outline (bookmarks) - every chapter starts on a new physical page, so the value is exact per page.

other_metadata.chapter_title: From the PDF outline, same as above.
other_metadata.section: Latest numbered section bookmark (e.g. '1.2 Input/output') that starts on or before the page. Approximate: sections often start mid-page, so the first half of a page can still belong to the previous section. Not used as a filter.
